verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships an HTTP server (`llama serve`), so offering a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an OpenAPI document or any equivalent machine-readable spec. The bare 'Server' entry and the serve command do not show that such a spec exists or can be downloaded.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
